jutsu.name: Windshear Decay
jutsu.description: Razor sharp wind slashes that leave lasting and decaying effects
jutsu.battleDescription: %user forms a series of intricate hand seals which summons forth the power of the winds that once quelled Fujin's fury. With a swift motion, they unleash a torrent of razor-sharp wind slashes that tear through the air towards %target. The wind howls with a vengeful fury, and as the invisible blades connect, they slice deep into %target's flesh, leaving behind festering wounds. The air around %target grows heavy with the scent of decay as the slashes begin to fester and deepen over time, continuing to tear at their flesh with each passing moment.

jutsu.name: Death's March
jutsu.description: Release waves of chakra that strikes your target
jutsu.battleDescription: %user envelops %target in a radiant chakra tunnel.  They unleash an unyielding wave of chakra, targeting their enemy's cells with relentless precision. As the assault subsides, the enemy's once-sturdy form crumbles, consumed by decay.

jutsu.name: Atomic Shield
jutsu.description: Create a barrier of particles to protect you
jutsu.battleDescription: %user creates a translucent barrier made of the particles around them to defend from all attacks

jutsu.name: Decaying Touch
jutsu.description: Touch your target and start to destroy their body through a dusty decay.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user creates a dust cloud that surrounds %target. Dashing through the cloud, they appear in front of %target, placing their hand on them. %target slashes at %user, and their body becomes dust. Only after the dust has disappeared does %target realize that the part of their body that was touched is beginning to decay.

jutsu.name: Particle Cannon
jutsu.description: The ultimate power comes with the ultimate price.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user weaves an intricate triangle with their fingers, bringing forth a radiant orb that caresses %user's hand with a warm glow that both energizes and burns. Gradually, the sphere transforms, unfurling into a brilliant beam, propelled with purpose towards %target

jutsu.name: Stormsinger
jutsu.description: A powerful stormy chakra surrounds the user.
jutsu.battleDescription: Calling upon the divine power of Susanoo, %user becomes one with the storm, their presence merging with the crackling energy in the air.

jutsu.name: Sounds of Tempest
jutsu.description: This jutsu channels lightning chakra through the target causing their very blood to become toxic to them.
jutsu.battleDescription: As the tempest rages, %user's eyes begin to glow with a dark blue radiance, mirroring the eye of the storm growing within, intensifying the ferocity and might of the unleashed power. %user then melds the forces of lightning and water, birthing "Akuma no Arashi", a cataclysmic storm of unparalleled power. The merging elements surge forth, enveloping %target and battlefield, a single bolt of lightning strikes them.

jutsu.name: Reapers Storm
jutsu.description: This jutsu unleashes a devastating lightning strike in the form of a demon that crashes through the clouds and slams into the target with immense force
jutsu.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra, summoning a torrent of water that cascades onto the battlefield in a tidal wave. The surging water drenches the area, leaving the opponent caught in the flow. With a crackling charge, %user infuses the water with lightning chakra, causing the terrain to spark and sizzle with electric energy

jutsu.name: Demons Strike
jutsu.description: Call down a powerful storm strike on an area while raising a temporary shield around yourself.
jutsu.battleDescription: as the storm rages on,  %user calls upon the power of the storm, forming a fearsome lightning strike from within the clouds. The demonic lightning descends with tremendous speed and force, crashing into %target with overwhelming power.

jutsu.name: Death’s Storm
jutsu.description: This jutsu summons a powerful storm of intense winds and torrential rain. Its raindrops become sharp needles that pierce the enemy and weaken their attacks.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user conjures a powerful storm, unleashing intense winds and torrential rain that soak %target(s). As the storm rages, the raindrops transform into sharp needles, piercing %target(s) and weakening the force of their attacks.

jutsu.name: Inferno Cataclysm
jutsu.description: Unleashes a devastating explosion
jutsu.battleDescription: Battle Description: %user channels the destructive power of their Bakuhatsu bloodline, their body surging with intense heat as the air around them distorts from the sheer energy. With a focused shout, %user slams their hands into the ground, causing the earth to tremble and crack. From the fissures erupts a cataclysmic explosion

jutsu.name: Kinetic Nova
jutsu.description: A blast of explosive chakra that disrupts all other chakra in the area
jutsu.battleDescription: %user condenses their chakra into a ball, flinging it at %target which explodes showering the area in the tiny explosions. %target soon realizes that its very hard to gather mold their elemental chakra.

jutsu.name: Blast Shield
jutsu.description: Using the concussive blast from an explosion to dampel the next attack you take.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user creatives a massive explosion around themselves neutralizing all attacks coming towards them.

jutsu.name: Charge 4 Explosion
jutsu.description: Spreading your chakra across the battle field causes micro-explosions to everything it comes into contact with.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user covers the battlefield with their explosive chakra. Small explosions can be seen and heard happening all around you.

jutsu.name: Howitzer Crash
jutsu.description: A devastating technique where you propel yourself at the target with an explosion before launching another massive explosion at them.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user explodes the space behind them launching themselves at the opponent then detonates themselves as soon as they get close enough. The explosion weakens the opponent defenses.

jutsu.name: Ring of Spilled Blood
jutsu.description: A spiral of spent blood is thrown across the ground. It opens what stands against the user, and what it opens, it weakens.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user spills a spiral across the ground and it turns outward, hungry. Enemies caught in the ring are opened, and their blows leave the circle duller than they entered.

jutsu.name: Crimson Tithe
jutsu.description: The user takes a toll in blood and time alike. The shock of the taking locks the victim in place, and what movement remains costs them dearly.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user reaches into the space between heartbeats and takes what is owed. %target staggers, locked mid-motion, and even time itself grows expensive around them.

jutsu.name: Sanguine Plague
jutsu.description: The user seeds a rival's blood with a burning sickness. The plague opens them to harm and eats at them from within, while the user's own blood refuses all affliction.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user flicks a drop of tainted blood onto %target and it takes root, burning as it spreads. %target is opened and eaten from within, while %user_object own veins run too hot for any sickness to touch.

jutsu.name: Reaper's Embrace
jutsu.description: The user closes in and drains their target directly, tearing vitality from them in a violent, inescapable exchange.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user lunges forward and crashes into %target, dragging %target close as crimson energy surges between them. With every heartbeat, %user rips vitality free, feeding on %target’s life as %user_object holds them through this vicious dance.

jutsu.name: Unholy Enhancement
jutsu.description: The user awakens a corrupted vitality, amplifying their strength while their body shrugs off harm with unnatural resilience.
jutsu.battleDescription: A dark pulse spreads through %user’s veins, quickening with hungry force. %user’s strikes land harder, fueled by something that does not tire, while blows from %target sink shallow, unable to fully pierce what refuses to weaken.

jutsu.name: Crimson Impact
jutsu.description: The user violently rends their target, leaving them exposed while siphoning vitality from the damage inflicted.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user rends %target with brutal force, tearing open deep, bleeding wounds. The injury lingers, raw and unclosing, as %user drinks from it, each pulse of pain feeding %user’s strength.

jutsu.name: Hemocure
jutsu.description: The user commands their blood to reject injury, sealing wounds and feeding on incoming harm to sustain an unnatural vitality.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user’s blood writhes beneath %user_object skin, surging against the flow of nature. Wounds seal shut as they form, and each strike from %target is devoured, strength stolen as %user refuses to fall.

jutsu.name: Thousand Strike
jutsu.description: The user unleashes a relentless barrage that shatters defenses, leaving the target exposed to further harm.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user descends in a frenzy of strikes, each blow tearing through %target with merciless precision. Defenses collapse under the onslaught, and in the wake of the assault, %target is left wide open, unable to withstand what follows.

jutsu.name: Icebound Might
jutsu.description: The wielder lets winter close over them like a second body. What it grips, it guards, and the cold it sheds sinks into their rival's every limb, dulling their blows before they land.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user plants the trident and the cold closes over %user like armor, plate after plate of pale ice. The chill hangs heavy on every swing at %user, and the blows that land arrive dulled, only settling the frost.

jutsu.name: Glacial Volley
jutsu.description: The wielder raises the Gaze and the air answers with an arsenal. A dozen lances of ice hang waiting, and every one of them has already chosen where it lands.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user raises the trident and the cold assembles into ranks: lance after lance of pale ice hanging in the air, every point aimed at %target. %user lowers the tines, and winter volleys.

jutsu.name: Ice Shackles
jutsu.description: The Gaze regards a rival and the cold agrees. Frost climbs them like a verdict, and for a breath the world simply declines to let them move.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user levels the trident and its three eyes narrow. Frost races up %target from the ground, locking joint after joint, until %target stands shackled in blue ice.

jutsu.name: Blade Resonance
jutsu.description: Synchronize your chakra with your weapon to deliver an icy strike that leaves the target vulnerable to Earth, Ice, Water, Wind and non-elemental attacks.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user channels their lineage through their weapon and forms a blade of ice, striking %target and disrupting their defenses against Earth, Ice, Water, Wind and non-elemental attacks.

jutsu.name: Blue Crimson
jutsu.description: Use your bloodline to teleport to different locations striking the enemy
jutsu.battleDescription: %user activates their bloodline, their eyes glow as patterned blades start to rotate in their pupils. %user disappears and reappears in seemingly random locations around %target, shifting his speed till his movements seem more illusionary than real. As %target becomes more and more disorientated, %user slashes and pierces %target from multiple angles.

jutsu.name: Quintessential Flake
jutsu.description: Using your blue blade, you turn your enemies ice pulling them towards you
jutsu.battleDescription: %user channels their Blue Blade unleashing its energy upon %target. The freezing the surrounding area.

jutsu.name: Sapphire Command
jutsu.description: A complex series of slashes drops your opponent to their knees before you.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user releases a pulse of Blue Blade chakra across the battlefield. As the wave passes through %target, their chakra flow freezes, increasing their vulnerability.

jutsu.name: Arctic Frost
jutsu.description: Coat your blade in ice chakra and attack your enemy
jutsu.battleDescription: Empowered by Blue Blade Eyes, %user chills the blade in elemental energy, encasing it in ice.

jutsu.name: Cosmic Intent
jutsu.description: A crushing gravitational distortion leaves the enemy vulnerable, continues to tear at them, and draws their vitality back to you.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user warps space around %target with swirling nebulas and crackling energy. Crushing gravity leaves %target vulnerable as the distortion continues to tear at them and channels stolen vitality back to %user.

jutsu.name: Cosmic Explosion
jutsu.description: Condense celestial energy into a volatile sphere that explodes around the target, dealing damage and leaving lasting wounds.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user releases a small purple ball into the center of the battlefield, the small ball begins to vibrate as a strong gravitational field begins to draw in %targets and the surrounding area. Once %targets reaches the center and makes contact with the sphere, it ignites causing a chain reaction of the entire area around %target igniting

jutsu.name: Cosmic Chains
jutsu.description: The user summons ethereal cosmic chains, forged from celestial energy, to bind their target. These luminous restraints drain power, suppressing their abilities while making them more vulnerable to attacks.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user extends their hand, summoning radiant cosmic chains from the void. The glowing restraints lash out, binding %target as celestial energy siphons their strength. Gravity warps around them, their power fading under the weight of the stars.

jutsu.name: Cosmic Energy
jutsu.description: The user channels the aura of the universe, infusing their body with boundless cosmic energy. Their power surges, enhancing all abilities while warping space around them with celestial force.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user's body radiates with cosmic energy, their form pulsing with the limitless power of the universe. Nebulas swirl around them, stars flickering in response to their ascension.

jutsu.name: Cosmic Aura
jutsu.description: The user’s presence warps reality, forming a celestial aura that suppresses the enemy’s strength while shielding them from harm. Space bends around them, reducing the impact of incoming attacks.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user emanates a radiant cosmic aura, distorting space itself. Stars shimmer in their wake as their presence suppresses %target’s power.

jutsu.name: Summoning: Jade
jutsu.description: Summon a beautiful but fierce warrior to the battlefield
jutsu.battleDescription: %user creates a cocoon made of crystal, out of it a beautiful warrior appears

jutsu.name: Kōsai Shippū
jutsu.description: Enhances speed and generates crystal-laced shockwaves.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user unleashes crystal shockwaves at %target, striking with speed and recoiling damage.

jutsu.name: Prism
jutsu.description: Channel the light from the sun to enlighten the battlefield
jutsu.battleDescription: %user unleashes a blinding prism of light, striking %target dealing a devastating blow leaving them wounded.

jutsu.name: Crystal Sphere
jutsu.description: Create a Sphere in which you protect yourself from all damage
jutsu.battleDescription: %user encases themselves in a sphere made of pure crystal

jutsu.name: Crystal Cave
jutsu.description: Create a cave made of Crystals to trap your target
jutsu.battleDescription: %user summons jagged crystals to impale %target, reducing their attack power and increasing the damage they take.

jutsu.name: Stardust
jutsu.description: New jutsu description
jutsu.battleDescription: %user performs strange handseals, each seal they perform a strange pattern appears on their body. As user glows, the surrounding area small dust like particles begins to fall from the heavens  covering the battlefield.

jutsu.name: Tamashī no Sakeme
jutsu.description: A devastating strike that cuts through both body and spirit.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user focuses their energy, and a dark aura begins to surround them. With a swift and decisive movement, they launch a blade of pure ethereal energy toward %target. This blade cuts through physical defenses like paper, but its true power lies in its ability to sever the connection between body and spirit. %target feels a cold, numbing pain as their very soul is sliced, leaving them disoriented, weakened, and vulnerable to further attacks. The wound left by this strike lingers, disrupting %target's chakra flow and making it difficult to recover.

jutsu.name: Founder’s Wrath
jutsu.description: Unleashes a massive attack by harnessing the origins of chakra.
jutsu.battleDescription: Drawing on the very origins of chakra, %user begins to chant an ancient incantation, their voice resonating with the primordial energy of creation. The ground trembles as elemental forces converge around %user—fire, water, earth, and lightning swirl into a tempest of raw power. With a final, commanding gesture, %user unleashes this elemental fury upon %target. The combined elements strike with devastating force, engulfing %target in a catastrophic storm that obliterates everything in its path. The sheer magnitude of the attack showcases the true power of the Heavenly Founder's legacy.

jutsu.name: Celestial Sealing
jutsu.description: Seals the enemy's bloodline abilities.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user's eyes glow with an ancient, divine energy, focusing intently on %target. With a series of intricate hand seals, they channel this energy into a binding force that surges towards %target. The celestial light surrounds %target, forming luminous chains that bind their body and spirit. These chains pulse with divine energy, penetrating deep into %target's chakra system. As %target struggles, %user completes the sealing technique, locking away %target's bloodline abilities. The celestial chains tighten, sealing %target's bloodline and rendering their unique abilities inert, leaving them vulnerable and powerless.

jutsu.name: Heavenly Constructs
jutsu.description: Creates chakra constructs for massive damage and defense.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user's hands move with fluid grace, channeling their chakra into pure, radiant energy. This energy takes form as shimmering constructs—spectral weapons, towering shields, and fierce guardian beasts. The battlefield is transformed into a scene of divine warfare, as these constructs move to both attack and protect. %target finds themselves besieged by a relentless barrage of ethereal blades and spectral beasts, each strike imbued with the raw power of %user's chakra. Simultaneously, %user is enveloped in a fortress of light, the constructs forming an impenetrable defense that deflects any incoming attacks.

jutsu.name: Starlight Veil
jutsu.description: Channels celestial energy to enhance both strength and protection.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user gazes upward, drawing in the shimmering essence of the stars. As the celestial energy courses through their veins, a radiant veil of starlight surrounds them. This ethereal barrier fortifies their defenses, while simultaneously enhancing their offensive prowess. With each attack, %user strikes with the force of a shooting star, and every incoming blow is softened by the veil's protective light.

jutsu.name: Shattered Reflection
jutsu.description: Reflects light to create clones and distort perception.
jutsu.battleDescription: With a flicker of their eyes, %user manipulates the surrounding light, creating multiple afterimages of themselves that confuse and disorient %target. These illusions mirror %target's attacks back at them, leaving them unsure of the true %user's position. Each reflection seems real until %target is struck by a precise blow from the shadows, capitalizing on their disoriented state.

jutsu.name: Lux
jutsu.description: An orb of light that explodes upon impact.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user creates an orb in the palm of one hand. Within the orb, small lights of multiple colors begin to form. As the orb grows, the lights brighten until four translucent rings appear around it. In an instant, %user appears in front of %target and strikes them in the chest with the orb. Upon impact, the orb explodes, and the translucent rings begin to tear %target apart.

jutsu.name: illuminance
jutsu.description: A forbidden technique passed down through the generations. Illuminate the entire battlefield.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user creates a jutsu formula  that spreads out from their feet. Acting as a honing signal, a bright pattern appears above %target . The chakra condenses and beams of light fire towards %target

jutsu.name: Chrono Stasis
jutsu.description: Distort time around an enemy, leaving them more vulnerable to incoming damage while accelerating your own movement through the altered flow.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user traps %target within a large translucent sphere of distorted time. The stasis leaves %target increasingly vulnerable while %user moves through the altered flow with accelerated timing.

jutsu.name: Imperial Swords
jutsu.description: Conjure mirrors and reflect rays of light to pierce your target.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user traps %target within a dense dome made of mirrors. Appearing above the dome, %user clasps their hands together, causing the mirrors to vibrate and swords of light to fire from them toward %target. Trapped in the middle, %target is unable to evade the barrage of swords.

jutsu.name: Celestial Harmony Shield
jutsu.description: Creates a barrier of harmonious sound waves and mystical energy.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user raises their hands gracefully, and a soft, ethereal melody begins to resonate through the air. The sound waves, infused with mystical chakra, form an invisible barrier that shimmers with a faint light. As the melody grows stronger, the barrier solidifies, creating a protective dome around %user. The harmonious vibrations disrupt incoming attacks, dissipating physical blows and nullifying elemental jutsu. The sound waves also have a calming effect, reducing the impact of mental and genjutsu assaults. The shield remains as long as the melody continues, providing %user with a serene, impenetrable defense.

jutsu.name: Foreboding Interlude
jutsu.description: Generate a soundwave that forces your target to kneel before you.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user snaps their fingers causing the chakra in the air to vibrate generating a distinct soundwave isolating them from the battle and clearing their mind

jutsu.name: Frozen Melody
jutsu.description: Freeze your target with a beautiful melody.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user creates a violin made from pure chakra. As each note rings across the battlefield, %target finds themselves unable to move.

jutsu.name: Harmonic Chamber
jutsu.description: Trap your target in a chamber of deadly music.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user summons a great chamber trapping %target inside, while target is busy trying to escape they hear a faint melody turns into a horrifying screech that ruptures %target eardrums leaving them withering in pain.

jutsu.name: Lullaby
jutsu.description: Cloud your enemy's sense of hearing and lure them to their death.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user creates a flute from the bones of their body, by imbuing chakra into the flute they begin to play  a harsh melody that slowly erodes %targets eardrums

jutsu.name: Magnetic Pulse Strike
jutsu.description: A powerful Taijutsu strike that generates a magnetic pulse to disorient and damage the opponent.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user gathers their chakra into their fists, charging it with magnetic energy. With a swift and precise movement, they strike %target directly. Upon impact, a shockwave of magnetic force radiates from the point of contact, distorting the magnetic fields around %target. This pulse disrupts their nervous system and balance, making them vulnerable to follow-up attacks.

jutsu.name: Rising Star
jutsu.description: A powerful Houkyuken uppercut.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user gathers their innate powers into their body. At the right moment, %user unleashes their power into a perfect rising uppercut smashing their fist into %target's chin for a devastating blow.

jutsu.name: Morning Star
jutsu.description: Channel ancient chakra to increase the effectiveness of your attack
jutsu.battleDescription: %user takes the Houkyuken stance, vanishing in a blur. In an instant, %target is launched skyward, where %user appears to deliver a relentless flurry of strikes before slamming them back to the ground with crushing force.

jutsu.name: Houkyuken: Magnetic Assignment
jutsu.description: Even your blood can be used as an effective weapon, thanks to your magnetic mastery and the iron in your blood.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user's blood hardens into a crimson steel-fist, glowing with inner power. With a rapid Houkyuken strike, they drive their fist into %target's stomach, forcing them to cough up blood from the devastating impact.

jutsu.name: Houkyu Dance
jutsu.description: The softer style of Houkyuken, which increases their movement and area of reach from their fists and kicks.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user releases a magnetic pulse, entering the Houkyu Dance. Enhanced by perfect awareness and the amplified speed from the magnetic field, %user unleashes a flawlessly coordinated series of devastating strikes upon %target.

jutsu.name: Glacial Descent: Cocytus
jutsu.description: Disables the enemy with the cold strength of a glacier, decreasing their overall prowess while increasing yours.
jutsu.battleDescription: Glacial Descent is a blizzard-style jutsu unique to the Hyouga Yui bloodline. It summons a tempest of icy winds and snowflakes, engulfing the battlefield in a swirling maelstrom of frost and sapphire hues.

jutsu.name: Nine Hell's Spear
jutsu.description: Nine Hells Spear is the signature damage-dealing jutsu of the Hyouga Yui clan. It channels the frigid essence of Glacier into a spear of ice, capable of piercing through the toughest defenses.
jutsu.battleDescription: As %user calls upon Nine Hells Spear, the air grows frigid. A spear of ice materializes in their hand, gleaming with an otherworldly light. With a swift motion, %user hurls the spear at the opponent, the icy projectile piercing through defenses and leaving behind a trail of frost.

jutsu.name: Cerulean Storm: Avalanche
jutsu.description: Cerulean Storm is a blizzard-style jutsu unique to the Hyouga Yui bloodline. It summons a tempest of icy winds and snowflakes, engulfing the battlefield in a swirling maelstrom of frost and sapphire hues.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user unleashes the ruthless power of the Hyouga Yui bloodline, eyes blazing with cold cerulean fury. Palms slam down—the earth shatters and flash-freezes into a vast, deadly ice field of jagged frost and slick mirrors under screaming arctic winds.

jutsu.name: Glacial Shatter: Purgatory
jutsu.description: The user creates a wave of freezing energy that shatters on impact, dealing widespread damage and freezing the surrounding area.
jutsu.battleDescription: As %user invokes Glacial Shatter, a surge of frigid energy erupts. The wave crashes, shattering on impact, freezing the surrounding area and leaving %target trapped in a field of ice and frost, their movements slowed by the biting cold and their chakra consumption increased.

jutsu.name: Glacier's Will
jutsu.description: Tapping into their special chakra a Glacier Shinobi can reinvigorate themselves during battle.
jutsu.battleDescription: As the battle rages, %user channels their unique chakra to invoke Glacier’s Will, enveloping themselves in a surging frosty aura and gleaming Ice Armor that bolsters defenses like an unbreakable glacial shield—fatigue instantly melts away, replaced by razor-sharp focus and renewed vigor. With the awakened fury of the Hyouga Yui bloodline, %user glides and dashes across the frozen terrain with blistering speed, each swift movement amplifying their strikes to deliver surging damage as they close in on foes with unbreakable resilience.

jutsu.name: Iron Web Entrapment
jutsu.description: Conjure magnetic wires to trap your opponent, slowing their resolve.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra into the ground, causing razor-sharp wires to erupt and form a vast web across the battlefield. The wires ensnare %target and nearby enemies, tightening with each movement, slicing through armor and flesh.

jutsu.name: Wire Blast Plus
jutsu.description: Itojinsei's Wind Style: Wire Blast
jutsu.battleDescription: %user channels Wind element to their steel wire bundle, %user hurtles their sharpened wire ball at %target the wires exploding on impact.

jutsu.name: Spiraling Wires
jutsu.description: This Itojinsei jutsu spears their target making them work harder to defend themselves.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user launches out multiple shuriken with wiries attached to them weaving them in an intricate pattern the shuriken strikes %target in their vital spots impairing their movement

jutsu.name: Lightning Threads
jutsu.description: Infuse lightning chakra into thin, thread-sharp wires to deliver lethal shocks.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user weaves an intricate dome-shaped cage made entirely of wires around %target. The wires tighten and constrict, restricting the target's movement and preventing escape. %user infuses lightning chakra into the wires to electrocute %target.

jutsu.name: Eternal Embrace
jutsu.description: The user conjures thin, razor-sharp wires, imbuing them with chakra. These wires can be controlled with precision, used for stealthy assassinations or to create intricate traps.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user performs Wire Strangle. Thin wires materialize, dancing with deadly grace, hurtles towards %target. %target is ensnared, the wires tightening with precision, leaving them incapacitated, and cutting deeply as %target struggles under the wires.

jutsu.name: Temporal Erosion
jutsu.description: Rapidly accelerates the target's timeline, causing them to decay and erode into dust.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user extends their hand, pulling particles from the surrounding air that shimmer with an otherworldly glow. The particles coalesce into jagged shards that gleam with distorted time energy. With a swift motion, %user launches the fragments at %target. The shards tear through the air, bending light and warping space as they collide with %target

jutsu.name: Abysmal End
jutsu.description: This jutsu creates a spiral of dust and air enveloping the enemy and collapsing against them with overwhelming force.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user engulfs %target in a spiral of dust, sapping their strength while boosting their own before collapsing it with devastating force.

jutsu.name: Singularity
jutsu.description: A Jutsu that displays the symbolism of the Kyuko-sei. The user manipulates fine dust particles infused with chakra, creating a volatile field that detonates upon command. This technique disperses microscopic shards that pierce targets,
jutsu.battleDescription: %user conjures a powerful gravitational core, tearing into %target and amplifying Dust, Wind, and Earth techniques

jutsu.name: Resonance
jutsu.description: Surround yourself with a dust-infused resonance that reflects incoming force and damages the target.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user releases a dust-infused pulse that reverberates around them, reflecting incoming force before striking %target.

jutsu.name: Ethereal Particle Storm
jutsu.description: The user unleashes a storm of charged particles imbued with temporal energy, blanketing the battlefield. These particles create unstable time zones where objects and enemies fluctuate between accelerated and decelerated states, creating chaos and opportunity.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user summons a shimmering cloud of dust particles that engulf %target, eroding their ability to strike effectively.

jutsu.name: Shadowrend
jutsu.description: Cursed tattoos allow the user’s strike to ignore defenses and inflict a shadow curse.
jutsu.battleDescription: With a pulse of malevolent chakra, %user's cursed tattoos flare to life, filling the air with shadowy energy. They strike at %target, bypassing all armor and barriers, as the cursed shadows cling to %target, seeping into their chakra network. This curse lingers in %target's system, amplifying the damage of future attacks. The shadows coil tightly around %target, ensuring that the next hit they suffer will be devastating, as the curse grows more potent with each passing moment.

jutsu.name: Cursed Beast Form
jutsu.description: The cursed tattoos fully cover the user, turning them into a creature of the shadows.
jutsu.battleDescription: With a dark incantation, %user activates the full power of their cursed tattoos, which crawl across their skin like living ink. The tattoos pulse with malevolent energy, overtaking %user’s entire form and warping them into a monstrous shadow creature. Claws extend from their hands, and their body becomes wreathed in dark energy. In this form, %user’s strength, speed, and resilience increase dramatically, their attacks leaving trails of shadow that cling to %target like a curse.

jutsu.name: Curse Empowerment
jutsu.description: The user absorbs dark energy from cursed tattoos, amplifying their strength.
jutsu.battleDescription: The cursed tattoos etched across %user’s body glow with ominous energy, drawing on the surrounding shadows to fuel their strength. As they attack %target, the dark tendrils of cursed energy lash out, not only delivering pain but channeling that energy back into %user.

jutsu.name: Shadow Tether
jutsu.description: Glowing tattoos summon shadows that deal a devastating wound to enemies
jutsu.battleDescription: %user’s tattoos glow as living shadows stretch toward %target and tighten around them. The tether tears into %target, leaving a deep wound that makes every movement more painful.

jutsu.name: Shadow Surge
jutsu.description: The user bonds with shadows, teleporting to a target while taking reduced damage.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user's tattoos glow a deep, ominous hue, their body dissolving partially into shadows. Vanishing from their position and reappearing beside the opponent. Cloaked in shadow, %user seems to shrug off attacks, the damage lessened as their form becomes one with the darkness.

jutsu.name: Shadow Domain
jutsu.description: A devastating shadow-infused attack that merges Yin and Yang energy with shadow manipulation, delivering a lethal blow that drains the opponent's vitality.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra, summoning the surrounding shadows to converge around %target. The shadows twist and elongate, forming sharp, ethereal blades that glint with a dark aura. With a swift motion, %user launches the shadows at %target. As the strike connects, the shadowy blades seep into %target's body

jutsu.name: Shadow Severance
jutsu.description: Shadow Severance enables the user to seize control of the target's shadow, summoning a scythe from the darkness. Through swift and precise movements, the user delivers strikes that sever both the physical form and the shadow of the target, leaving them without identity or substance.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user channels the power of the Shadow Weaver Bloodline, asserting dominance over %target's shadow. Emerging from the darkness, a scythe materializes, a manifestation of the shadow's chilling embrace. With unparalleled speed and precision, %user delivers devastating strikes, severing both the physical form and the shadow of %target, leaving them without an identity, a mere shell of their former self.

jutsu.name: Shadow Step
jutsu.description: A skillful maneuver that blurs the boundaries between visibility and concealment. Through an artful melding with the enveloping shadows, the practitioner's presence becomes near-invisible, seamlessly blending into the darkness that surrounds them
jutsu.battleDescription: %user seamlessly melds with nearby shadows, becoming an elusive wraith in the dimness. Swift as a moonlit breeze, they materialize in a surge of shadow energy just behind the opponent. Seizing the advantage of stealth, %user initiates an ambush with heightened potency, catching the opponent off guard and delivering a forceful strike that inflicts substantial damage.

jutsu.name: Shadow Shell
jutsu.description: Becoming one with the Shadows gives this Shinobi the edge they need in battle.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user envelopes themselves in darkness as their power reinvigorates %user becomes a pillar of shadows imposing a menacing figure as the battle continues.

jutsu.name: Shadow Dance
jutsu.description: A mesmerizing spectacle unfolds as the wielder's weapon becomes an integral part of their very essence. This intricate choreography of combat seamlessly melds martial finesse with the power of the Shadow Weaver bloodline.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user's weapon becomes an extension of their body as they engage in a mesmerizing dance of combat. With swift, rhythmic movements, %user strikes and slashes, each motion releasing bursts of shadow energy that cascade toward %target, inflicting a series of rapid and devastating blows. The seamless fusion of %user's mastery over shadows and their weapon creates a captivating and lethal performance on the battlefield.

jutsu.name: Yozakura: Sakura Dragon Pearl
jutsu.description: As wind and fire chakra converge, a glowing sphere takes shape, pulsing in resonance with the Sakura Dragon Tree. Petals spiral inward, fusing into a radiant pearl that enters the user’s body, igniting a healing fire that restores balance and strength from within.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user forming a glowing pearl of flame and petal light that surges into their chest, reigniting their strength before %target can strike again.

jutsu.name: Yozakura: Dancing Embers
jutsu.description: A storm of wind chakra whips through the flame blossoms of the Sakura Dragon Tree, lifting them into a blinding violet blaze. The swirling torrent surges forward like dancing dragons, leaving scorched trails and reduced damage in their wake.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user stirring the flame blossoms into a violent vortex that lashes out at %target in a blazing spiral.

jutsu.name: Hiru-Sakura: Sakuragari
jutsu.description: A spiraling lance of burning cherry blossom petals forms from the swirling wind, hurled with violent force toward the enemy. Just before impact, the lance blossoms apart into a storm of flaming petals, searing everything in its path.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user uses Hiru-Sakura: Sakuragari, forming a lance of swirling petals that shatters near %target into a wave of burning blossoms.

jutsu.name: Hiru-Sakura: Sakura-ame
jutsu.description: Infusing chakra into a cloud above their opponent, the user is able to make it rain blossom petals that distort enemy senses.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user infuses their chakra into a cloud above %target gradually changing the cloud's color into a mix of pink and violet, %user clenches their hand as an extreme amount of blossom petals begin fall from the cloud like rain, overwhelming %target senses

jutsu.name: Asazakura – Sakura Dragon Tree
jutsu.description:
Summons the legendary Sakura Dragon Tree—its darkened trunk erupting from the battlefield, crowned in blazing pink and violet flame blossoms.

The tree remains rooted in place, scorching nearby enemies and empowering all fire and scorch-based techniques used by the caster. Its presence marks the battlefield with beauty and devastation alike.

A symbol of rebirth and destruction, this is the first blossom of the Nikko no Hana's legacy.
jutsu.battleDescription: Flames blossom from the earth as %user casting burning petals toward %target in a dazzling display of wrath and grace.

jutsu.name: Storm Style: Daibutsu Thunder
jutsu.description: Unleashes a torrent of electrified water, overwhelming enemies.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user raises their hands to the sky, gathering their chakra and calling forth a massive storm. With a swift motion, %user brings their hands down, summoning a torrential wave of water infused with lightning. The wave crashes toward %target, the water swirling violently as bolts of lightning strike from within, making escape nearly impossible. As the electrified water engulfs %target, the intense shock and pressure from the current deal devastating damage. The storm rages for a few moments, leaving the battlefield drenched and charged with residual electrical energy, hindering actions.

jutsu.name: Izanagi's Hammer
jutsu.description: Brings down a lightning-infused hammer to crush all in its path.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user summons the divine power of Izanagi’s hammer, using it to rapidly close the distance, smashing %target

jutsu.name: Indra's Storm Cloak
jutsu.description: You cover your body in lightning and water chakra causing those that attack you to be struck in return
jutsu.battleDescription: %user cloaks themselves in their storm chakra; using themselves as the epicenter lightning strikes the battlefield

jutsu.name: Storm Style: Divine Railgun
jutsu.description: You fire off an attack at inhuman speeds utilizing the properties of lightning and water's conductivity.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user coats small pebble in water chakra, then using lightning, they supercharge it sending it flying toward %target before they can even react, inflicting massive injury with what seems like just a flick of a finger.

jutsu.name: Strike: Raijin
jutsu.description: The culmination of your Bloodline limit, you create thunderclouds above the battlefield that rain down lightning indiscriminately, destroying everything.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user summons up thunderclouds in the sky, charging their body with chakra, they disappear from the field of battle and strike down from the heavens on %target

jutsu.name: Exploding Wood Serpent
jutsu.description: Summon an exploding wooden serpent
jutsu.battleDescription: %user creates a wooden statue, the eyes of the statue starts to glow as a wooden serpent starts wrapping itself around %target then explodes

jutsu.name: Guardian's Grove
jutsu.description: Trap your enemy in a cave filled with poison.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user traps %target in a wooden cave, inside the cave are poisonous plants that release toxic gas, debilitating %target

jutsu.name: Forest Wisdom
jutsu.description: Listen to your ancestors and learn from their previous battles.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user stands still on the battlefield as a green aura surrounds them. They see memories of their ancestors' battles play out in front of them, blessing them with the wisdom of those long gone.

jutsu.name: Wood Style: Wood Warrior Summon
jutsu.description: Summon your ancestors’ sacred guardian.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra to summon a towering wooden warrior, a living construct to shield and fight.

jutsu.name: Eternal Forest
jutsu.description: Trap your enemy in a never ending Forest.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user claps their hands together and releases a massive amount of chakra, the earth starts to shake and crack open as massive tree limbs start shooting upward into the sky. Suddenly a branch springs forth dragging %target into the path of the onrushing roots.

jutsu.name: Lightning Release
jutsu.description: Encase yourself in lightning natured chakra
jutsu.battleDescription: %user generates lightning nature charka around their entire body

jutsu.name: Wind Release
jutsu.description: Calls forth a silent and swirling vortex to envelop and confuse.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra into the air, creating a silent cyclone that spirals onto the battlefield

jutsu.name: Element Divine
jutsu.description: Generate 5 cyclones of elemental chakra that collides against each other.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user generates 5 cyclones of elemental chakra around %target. With precise control each cyclones converges on %target

jutsu.name: Fire Release
jutsu.description: A Flaming lotus that wraps it selfs around the target
jutsu.battleDescription: %user conjures a flicker flaming lotus of With a whispered chant, the lotus blossoms mid-air — and from it burst dozens of petal-like fragments that streak toward %target

jutsu.name: Water Release
jutsu.description: Surround yourself in a dome of water rejuvenating your mind and body
jutsu.battleDescription: %user presses their feet to the ground, releasing water nature chakra that envelops them in a dome, the water chakra is filled with healing minerals that  slowly heals the %user wounds

jutsu.name: Earth Release
jutsu.description: Create a mauseleum of stone around yourself
jutsu.battleDescription: %user entombs themselves in a rock formation protecting them from all sides

jutsu.name: Lava Wave
jutsu.description: Unleashes a tidal wave of lava.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user molds their chakra with earth and fire, creating a towering wave of molten lava. With a swift motion, they release the wave, which cascades forward like a burning tsunami. %target faces the oncoming tide, but the overwhelming heat and pressure make escape nearly impossible. As the wave crashes, it incinerates everything in its wake, leaving behind a molten landscape.

jutsu.name: Blow of Devastation
jutsu.description: The user draws on their lineage to unleash a taxing surge of magma that leaves the opponent vulnerable.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user draws deeply upon their bloodline, molten energy surging across their body as layers of living magma harden into blazing armor. With a decisive stomp, %user sends rivers of lava coiling around %target. The effort strains %user, while the intense heat disrupts %target’s defenses and leaves them vulnerable to further attacks.

jutsu.name: Eruption Strike
jutsu.description: Combines physical strikes with erupting lava bursts.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user charges forward with unmatched speed, their fists and feet glowing with molten heat. Each strike they deliver erupts in a burst of lava, searing %target's flesh and armor. The combination of raw physical power and scorching lava leaves a trail of destruction, overwhelming %target with relentless fiery assaults.

jutsu.name: Magma Slayer
jutsu.description: This jutsu enables the user to sacrifice some of their life force to summon an incredible, dangerous ally.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user utilizes the power of their lineage along with some of their own life force to conjure from the molten depths a humanoid, magma form. As husk arises, an incredible heatwave is formed around the area. This husk emanates incredible temperatures and looks at %user's opponent with murderous intent and they prepare for the slaughter.

jutsu.name: Infernal Stream
jutsu.description: This jutsu combines the user's incredible physical strength with the explosive power of their bloodline.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user channels the power of their bloodline and slams their fists on the ground and channels incredible power into the environment around them. After a brief respite, the battlefield around the opponent shakes as geysers erupt around. Suddenly, %user barrages the opponent with incredible speed and power. With every hit landed, a geyser erupts and showers the opponent with powerful blasts of magma.

jutsu.name: Solar Reverb
jutsu.description: Focus the sun's radiance into a scorching blast that burns enemies and leaves searing light behind.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user channels Amaterasu’s radiance into the battlefield beneath %target. Searing solar energy erupts on impact and continues to scorch the surrounding ground.

jutsu.name: Incandescent Nova
jutsu.description: Incandescent Nova showcases extreme control over the scorch release, summoning a radiant nova that converges on a target and evaporates a massive area in an instant.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user performs a series of hand signs, unleashing a surge of chakra that forms a radiant nova around %target. The area rapidly evaporates as the nova converges inward, erupting in a devastating blast that inflicts lasting burns through simultaneous heat and dehydration.

jutsu.name: Celestial Ignition
jutsu.description: This technique enables the user to focus their innate bloodline mastery. As light gathers around them, their jutsu flows more easily, enhancing offense while making it harder for enemies to face such blinding brilliance.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user fuses wind and fire chakra into a veil of pure light, enhancing jutsu control while dazzling %target with blinding radiance.

jutsu.name: Radiant Embers
jutsu.description: You release radiant embers that sap your target's strength while gathering into a protective solar shield around you.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user conjures small solar orbs that dance around %target, weakening their attacks before forming a radiant shield around %user.

jutsu.name: Stellar Inferno
jutsu.description: Invoke a celestial inferno that engulfs the battlefield in scorching radiance. Blinding light and intense scorch chakra devastate the area, leaving lasting destruction.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user calls upon the sun’s full power, evaporating the air around %target. As scorched oxygen enters their body, it dehydrates them from within, leaving them gasping and burning.

jutsu.name: Cryostorm Aegis
jutsu.description: Encases the user in a protective storm of ice and snow, slowing enemies.
jutsu.battleDescription: As %user channels their chakra, the air around them begins to swirl with a sudden, fierce wind. In an instant, snow and ice materialize from the atmosphere, forming a spiraling vortex that envelops %user. The howling storm acts as a formidable shield, repelling attacks with its sheer intensity. Shards of ice dance within the tempest, deflecting projectiles and chilling any who dare approach. The very ground around %user becomes slick with frost, hampering the movement of the enemy and slowing their advance. The Cryostorm Aegis not only guards against harm but turns the battlefield into a frozen nightmare for the enemy, their every movement hindered by the biting cold and relentless winds.

jutsu.name: Imperial Freeze
jutsu.description: Imperial Freeze is an awe-inspiring jutsu belonging to the heirs of the cursed Teno Yuki lineage. This technique harnesses the elemental forces of water, wind, and ice to create an overwhelming and majestic frozen storm.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user channels the essence of their bloodline, summoning the regal power of Imperial Freeze. With a series of precise hand signs, an immense blizzard erupts around %target, the air thick with shimmering ice crystals and freezing winds. The temperature plummets, and %target finds themselves ensnared in an exquisite yet deadly prison of ice. The biting cold gnaws at their strength, and the dazzling ice formations disorient their senses, making it difficult to tell friend from foe. The battlefield transforms into a majestic yet merciless winter landscape, showcasing the overwhelming authority of %user and the chilling grandeur of Imperial Freeze.

jutsu.name: Ice Coffin
jutsu.description: Trap your target in a coffin made of ice.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user calls forth an icy gust that washes over %target. Within an instant, %target finds themselves trapped within an ice coffin. %target Desperately tries to break the ice but each time they hit the surface of the coffin they only injury themselves as the snow covers them.

jutsu.name: Frostbound Ascendancy
jutsu.description: Empowers the user’s ice jutsu, creating a frost field.
jutsu.battleDescription: Drawing on the ancient power of the Teno Yuki, %user summons a surge of freezing energy. Their body becomes a conduit for the icy might of their bloodline, as frost spreads from their feet, enveloping the battlefield.

jutsu.name: Ice Palace
jutsu.description: The sheer power of this jutsu serves as a testament to the user's profound connection with the icy elements
jutsu.battleDescription: %user summons forth a great mist that obscure the vision of %target wrapped in this mist %target is taken into an icy palace, striken by the cold %target tries to escape but each step they take decreases their body temperature until they fall into a frozen coma

jutsu.name: Moonlit Inferno
jutsu.description: Unleashes a fiery, electrified moonlight that damages, weakens, and exposes the enemy.
jutsu.battleDescription: Beneath the silver glow of the moon, %user channels the fiery and electrifying power of Yin-Yang. A brilliant, searing light descends upon %target, infused with the destructive essence of both fire and lightning. The moonlit flames scorch deeply, while arcs of lightning crackle through the air, striking with deadly precision. The burning energy saps the strength of %target, dulling their ability to strike back and leaving them vulnerable to further devastation. As the moon’s radiant fury peaks, %user becomes a beacon of power, the night alight with the dual forces of fire and lightning, reshaping the battle with an overwhelming force.

jutsu.name: Silent Rift
jutsu.description: Silent Rift is a swift and elusive jutsu of the Tenohira Musei bloodline. It allows the user to instantaneously close the gap between themselves and their opponent, appearing next to them in a blur of Yin-Yang energy.
jutsu.battleDescription: With a surge of chakra, %user vanishes from sight, leaving behind a faint trail of shimmering energy. In the blink of an eye, %user reappears beside the opponent, the air crackling with residual Yin-Yang energy as they prepare to strike. The suddenness of the maneuver catches the opponent off-guard, allowing %user to take advantage of their proximity for a swift and decisive attack.

jutsu.name: Yin-Yang Cascade
jutsu.description: Yin-Yang Cascade is an advanced technique of the Tenohira Musei bloodline, unleashing a powerful wave of Yin-Yang energy that disrupts the chakra flow of all targets within its range, leaving them weakened and disoriented.
jutsu.battleDescription: As %user unleashes Yin-Yang Cascade, a torrent of swirling energies erupts from their outstretched hands. The wave surges forward, engulfing %target in its path. As it crashes over %target, their chakra is disrupted, leaving them staggered and weakened, their movements slowed as they struggle to regain their balance amidst the chaotic energies.

jutsu.name: Silent Palm Strike
jutsu.description: Silent Palm Strike is a fundamental technique of the Tenohira Musei bloodline, utilizing Yin-Yang Release to disrupt an opponent's chakra flow upon contact with a precise strike of the palm.
jutsu.battleDescription: With a focused gaze and steady breath, %user channels the power of Tenohira Musei, infusing their palm with Yin-Yang energy. %user swiftly closes the distance to %target, their hand poised to strike. As the palm makes contact, a surge of potent Yin-Yang energy erupts, sending a shockwave through %target’s body, immediately disrupting their chakra flow. In the aftermath, intricate symbols begin to flare across %target’s skin, forming a restrictive seal that targets and suppresses their bloodline abilities. This sealing effect weakens %target, cutting off access to their inherited powers and leaving them vulnerable to follow-up attacks.

jutsu.name: Eternal Stillness
jutsu.description: Ensnares all in unending lunar stillness.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user calls forth the moon’s eternal stillness, casting a shadow of timeless peace across the battlefield. In this serene dominion, both %user and %target find themselves unable to alter their power or weaknesses. The world seems to hold its breath, as all movement of strength and vulnerability is frozen beneath the moon's unwavering glow.

jutsu.name: Liquid Ember Shell
jutsu.description: Encases the user in a shell of molten fire and water.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user merges fire and water chakra to form a molten liquid shell that absorbs attacks, with fire burning weaker assaults and water dissipating impacts, providing adaptive defense against various threats.

jutsu.name: Drowning Strike
jutsu.description: A fist of boiling water to the face.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user covers their fist in scorching hot water before striking %target in the face, forcing most of that water down their nostrils.

jutsu.name: Surfing Strike
jutsu.description: A series of gliding movements atop boiling water
jutsu.battleDescription: %user unleashes a torrent of water, flooding the battlefield. Using their Boil affinity, they glide seamlessly over the steaming surface, while the boiling water scalds %target causing %user to take less damage.

jutsu.name: Scorch Break
jutsu.description: Your most basic technique as a wielder of the Boil style
jutsu.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra into their palms, turning it into steaming liquid. Dashing forward, %user unleashes a flurry of punches, each strike searing %target's body and leaving burn marks in its wake.

jutsu.name: Azure Dragon Palm
jutsu.description: Land devasting blows from the safety of your dragon.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user summons a water dragon that encases them like armor. Dashing toward %target, each strike they deliver is mirrored by the dragon, landing devastating blows that leave %target battered and overwhelmed.
